name: Trials of the dark sea
author: ericvilcu
description: A short game made for the 2022 WASM-4 jam: steer a small red craft through a dark sea dotted with glowing lights.

descriptions.en: A short game made for the 2022 WASM-4 jam: steer a small red craft through a dark sea dotted with glowing lights.
descriptions.it: Un breve gioco creato per la jam di WASM-4 del 2022: guida una piccola imbarcazione rossa in un mare scuro punteggiato di luci.
